notes: translategemma serves its own chat template in-process; Qwen3 is the fallback. mlx-lm cannot load T5 (VTSNLP/trans_model_vi_en) and plamo-2-translate is en<->ja only. mic_device_index null = system default; stt_backend 'auto' runs Whisper on the GPU via mlx-audio when available (large-v3-turbo: 3.1x realtime on CPU, 31x on GPU) and falls back to the CPU otherwise.
